text.value: Review organisation accounts, invitations, runtime settings, notices and privacy request cases. Account, invitation and runtime-settings displays are read live from protected Identity and Access read models. Role grants, group membership and assignments are managed in the IAM application.
Organisation accounts are read live from protected Identity and Access data; no account directory is copied into this application. Role grants run in the IAM application, never here.

Pending and past invitations are read live from protected Identity and Access data. Invitations carrying intended role assignments follow the governed IAM journey; this application offers no grant control.
View the organisation's runtime settings. Select the settings record to edit it through the protected record save.
